# 2.1 Hazardous energy control — LOTO

**DANGER — Electric shock:** The cabinet carries 400 V AC. Switch off and lock the main switch before opening the cover.

1. Stop the machine.
2. Turn the main switch to 0.
   1. Fit the padlock.
   2. Attach the tag.
3. Verify zero energy by measurement.
